0022600202.text: The Miami Heat (3-6, 9th in the East, 3 games back in the Southeast) come into this 10th game of their season on a one-game losing streak, with a 2-3 road record. The Sacramento Kings (1-8, 15th in the West) have lost two straight and are 0-4 at home, and they will be without Domantas Sabonis (knee soreness), Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with Miami winning the last meeting 130-117 in Sacramento on January 20, 2026, and no games have yet been played in the 2026-27 series.
